item.description:
✨ New Features

  • Revamped closed-notch HUD and live-activity transitions with unified collapse-expand choreography
  • Added lock screen mini-widgets
  • Added sneak peek duration slider
  • Added compact calendar all-day events toggle
  • Added pull down gesture reactivity to compact mode
  • Added option to disable app icon on album art
  • Added info popup for macOS 26+ menu bar icon toggle that redirects to System Settings
  • Added blur and flash to album art flip transition
  • Compact mode media player title is now tappable to open the media source app

🔧 Fixes

  • Moved notch appearance settings to Appearance tab
  • Fixed cpu/memory usage across notch, timers, and settings
  • Fixed debug session OOM kill from CGEvent tap leak + unbounded thumbnail cache
  • Fixed the notch open/close drift & ghosting bug + restored liquid bounce on open
  • Fixed home to tray switch revealing unmasked glass + disabled glass on solid black appearance
  • Fixed sneak peek expand animation
  • Fixed edge fade blocking text on sneak peek + fixed paused state for youtube thumbnails
  • Fixed gesture settings including horizontal gestures to skip track + fixed sneak peek resetting glass mask background
  • Fixed shuffle and repeat active indicator + fixed source media app repeat sync
  • Fixed compact calendar view snapping to media view during close
  • Fixed lock hud persisting on unlock
  • Fixed default HUD sizing
  • Fixed concave top corner + extended duration for expanded battery HUD
  • Fixed browser tabs showing app icon instead of grey note fallback for no-artwork tracks
  • Fixed macbook icon to match actual mac model
  • Fixed bluetooth expanded hud corners
  • Fixed settings window focus
  • Fixed compact mode ui opening on file drag
  • Airdrop and bluetooth HUD fixes
  • Volume and brightness hud adjustments
  • Gated liquid glass notch appearances behind macOS 26+ and improved lock screen widget styling on versions below macOS 26
  • Implemented a second potential fix for liquid glass mask lagging issue
  • Made toggles in settings respect compact mode capability + adjusted system HUD UI
  • Changed media button click reactivity to scale whole button including highlight during click, not after
  • Increased view transition blur + all-day event pill adjustments
  • Reworked 'not playing' placeholder art
  • Increased waveform size on compact view
  • Changed artist names to use .medium
  • Changed airdrop symbol
  • Removed custom visualiser

✨ New Features

  • Added compact UI mode

🔧 Fixes

  • Fixed mirror widget sizing
  • Fixed issue where calendar wheel hover recognition prevented gesture reactivity
  • Added blur effect on notch open and close
  • Implemented a potential fix for liquid glass black mask lagging during notch open animation
  • Added release notes to update popup in settings
  • Added airdrop progress HUD toggle to settings

✨ New Features

  • Added airdrop notifications

🔧 Fixes

  • Fixed shuffle sync with media source app
  • Fixed airpods battery level detection
